name: Reward Prediction
description: Dopaminergic coding of reward prediction errors: midbrain dopamine neurons signal the difference between expected and actual reward. Drives learning of stimulus-reward and action-reward associations. Extends beyond reward to uncertainty and salience.
key_references: Schultz, W., Dayan, P., & Montague, P. R. (1997). A neural substrate of prediction and reward. Science, 275(5306), 1593-1599.
Watkins, C. J. (1989). Learning with Delayed Rewards. PhD Dissertation, Cambridge University.
empirical_evidence: Well-characterized in primate electrophysiology (Schultz). Single-unit recordings show phasic dopamine bursts to unexpected rewards and reward omissions. Learning rate correlates with dopamine signaling. Striatal dopamine receptors critical for reinforcement learning. Debate: does DA signal scalar reward or vector value?
